notes.title: Available languages upon release!
notes.notes:
Just two more days until Cross of the Dutchman will be released on Steam! In this article we wanted to announce that Cross of the Dutchman will be available in multiple languages! We have a team of enthusiasts who are working very hard to help us translate the game to as many languages as possible.

We have a selection of languages that will be available this Thursday upon the release of the game, but we will add more more languages once the game is released:

- English
- Dutch
- Frisian (the language that is spoken in Friesland where the game takes place!)
- Brazilian-Portuguese
- Spanish
- Russian

You can expect the following languages to be added with updates once the game is released. We don’t have a solid schedule yet for the updates, but we want to have these languages available to you as soon as possible!

- German
- Danish
- Bulgarian
- Swedish
- Italian
- Polish
- French

Once again, a huge THANK YOU to all those who are helping us translate Cross of the Dutchman. Not only are you allowing people from all over the world to enjoy the game in their native language, but you’re helping us in making a piece of history known to as many people as possible.

http://www.triangle-studios.com/press/cross_of_the_dutchman/images/Cross%20of%20the%20Dutchman%20-%202.png

More information
Official website: http://crossofthedutchman.com 
Twitter: http://twitter.com/trianglestudios 
Facebook: http://facebook.com/crossofthedutchman 
YouTube: http://youtube/TriangleStudiosNL
